decisions.reason: The web hosting management platform is the flagship of the firm's agency-focused direction and is central to its automation promise, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan is core to the hosting offer for scalable agency projects and is likely to stay, though it could be restructured or merged into other plans.
Extended PHP security support fits the firm's security and compliance focus and helps customers running legacy projects, though it may be adjusted as specific PHP versions reach end of life.
